name: collapsible-module-groups
goal: Every Explorer catalog and relationship group can collapse independently with an accessible heading control, remains open by default, and preserves its cards, counts and keyboard navigation

evidence: Default-open independent heading disclosures across 8 catalog kinds, Used In/Uses groups, and Styles. Heading/count remain visible; Enter, Space and pointer toggle; search reveals matching cards. Preserve card markup and View More paging. Full CLI/native suite remains deferred by Daniel.
